ᛟ Odin's Throne — tree display redesign · issue #7 prototype · v3.9.1 stones overlay the eleven painted lanterns — one seat per lantern, a max of 11 active namespaces; the active world's stone opens (teal ring) while every other stone fades into the background, z-below the active one · the whole scene scrolls together, the task list always attached to its lantern · vine curls out to the branch rail at 44% · icons pop down to vine anchors · «/» compact toggle — one-line cards, no clasps
mode
states
ᛉ the world-tree worlds read live from the backend API — one vine open at a time · eleven lantern seats

what the tree means

  • world list read live from the backend service API (/api/namespaces) — never hardcoded; lantern seats assigned by curated id, djb2-hashed for unknown worlds
  • trunk the painted moonlit tree of life — tall and narrow in the panel's left half, regenerated with /imagen (prompt committed in src/ui/assets/README.md)
  • stone one namespace (a world) — a stone overlaying a painted leaf-lantern, carrying its icon; the active world's stone opens (teal ring), all others fade into the background (ghost icons over the painting) · eleven lanterns — a max of 11 active namespaces
  • berries status counts — succeeded · running · failed; hidden on the open world (its work is on the vine)
  • vine one world open at a time — its vine curls out to the branch rail at 44% and the job cards descend it as work grows; painting, stones and vine scroll as one, the list never detaching from its lantern
  • task pips ONE row under a collapsed lantern's status counts, growing left→right in hang order (running → failed → pending → succeeded) like a progress bar, +N past 8 — expanding hides the whole cluster, the icons popping down to the vine anchors
  • anchor icon each job's status sigil seats ON the vine where its card ties on — the title box carries text only, no icon inside
  • job card name, title, issue #, agent — actions are icon-only (📌 ✕, tooltip explains), clasping the bottom border flush right
  • spores drift gold while the WS feed is live

job states

  • running moon-blue, breathing glow
  • succeeded steady moss-green
  • failed ember flicker
  • pending dim, unhatched
  • selected teal ring on leaf + lantern
  • purged the leaf falls from its shoot

try it

  • hover a lantern world name + full stats line
  • click a lantern its vine grows; the last one retracts
  • click a card its session opens in a tab (or focuses + refreshes)
  • pin / cancel act right on the card — no popups anywhere
  • long vine many jobs? the vine extends and the panel scrolls
  • cancel the card falls from the vine, its tab closes
  • compact toggle the « button in the tree header — compact at ANY pane width; click again for the standard tree
  • compact card ONE line — title + status dot; no session/issue/agent meta, no action clasps; rows packed tight on the vine
